sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to extend their impressive form. Sandbach are unbeaten in their last five matches (four wins and a draw) and sit top of the table with 22 points from 10 games. They face a struggling Alsager Town side who are second-bottom with just 4 points and have lost their last five games, making this a strong opportunity for Sandbach to maintain their title challenge.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture between mid-table sides, with Stafford looking to close the two-point gap on leaders Sandbach after their recent draw. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a clash between high-flying teams—Bridgnorth have won five of their last six after a rare loss, while Eccleshall have bounced back from their most recent defeat. Wolverhampton Casuals welcome Wednesfield Community in a contest between two sides in the upper half. Bilston Town (fifth) travel to Foley Meir in a matchup of mid-table teams, while Barnton host Shawbury United; Shawbury are struggling at the bottom with five consecutive losses. New Mills visit Market Drayton Town in a fixture between struggling sides, with both teams battling to move away from the relegation zone. Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a bottom-half encounter, and Crewe host Allscott Heath in another lower-table affair. Finally, Brereton Social welcome Widnes Town; Widnes are rooted to the bottom with just 2 points and have lost five of their last six.
